title: Three Months and One Short Scale
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：shop　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shop 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the shopkeeper ① openned the shop that no buyer in the shop would have measured, and he said the openning was the whole of the month. The ② shop, meaning the store itself and not the scale, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; a shop, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ shop in that shop had the same short scale beside it, and the ④ shop at the far counter, meaning the coin they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A shop, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the shopkeeper said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the shop was the whole of the matter, meaning the livelihood and not the store. The ⑥ shop, meaning the livelihood and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; shop, he said, is either something you open or the only word that means both a store and a livelihood. He said the livelihood is the part they remember.

By 1959 the ⑦ shop had become a line in an account, and the account had become an argument about the short scale. The ⑧ shop of the whole thing, the shopkeeper wrote in July, was one shop and three months of measuring; shop, he said, is either the coin at the far counter or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ shop I remember is the store measured in the account, which closed in 1961 and is still measured as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ shop, my mother said in 1963, is the only store that improves by being measured; every shop, she said, is a livelihood that has agreed to look like a store. She said the livelihood was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 商店（指铺子里每一家旁边的那一家）
B. n. 商店（指那家商店本身，与小小的秤相对）
C. 固定搭配：open the shop 开这一家商店
D. n. 商店（指留给孩子们数的那一枚）
E. n. 商店之事（抽象总称，指一处铺子的商店之事）
F. n. 商店（指账本里写到、被测量的那一家）
G. n. 商店、营生（指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 营生（抽象总称，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: openned the shop that no buyer in the shop would have measured
The shop, meaning the store itself and not the scale
the shop at the far counter
the shop was the whole of the matter
the shop had become a line in an account
The shop of the whole thing
A shop, my mother said in 1963

answers.why: open the shop 意为“开这一家商店”，1954 年那位掌柜把铺子里没有一位买主肯测量的一家商店做了一遍。
shop 意为“商店”，指那家商店本身而不是小小的秤，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
shop 意为“商店”，指铺子里每一家旁边的那一家，每一家旁边都有同一杆小小的秤。
shop 意为“商店”，指最远那张柜台的留给孩子们数的那一枚，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
shop 意为“商店、营生”，指一件事里人人都买却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这家营生就是那件事的全部。
shop 意为“营生”，指人人都买却无人提起的那样东西而不是那家商店，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
shop 意为“商店”，指账本里写到、被测量的那一家，到 1959 年这一家成了账本里的一行。
shop 意为“商店之事”，掌柜七月写道，整件事的商店之事是一处铺子和三个月份的测量。
shop 意为“商店”，我记得的是账本里测量过的那一家，1961 年结清了，至今仍被说成铺子里最安静的一家。
shop 为抽象总称，母亲 1963 年说，商店是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的商店。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1954 年那位掌柜开了铺子里没有一位买主肯测量的一家商店，他说这一遍才是那个月份的全部。（open the shop）
那家商店，指的是那家商店本身而不是小小的秤，经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。（shop）
那处铺子里每一家商店旁边都有同一杆小小的秤。（shop）
最远那张柜台那家商店，指的是他们留给孩子们数的那一枚，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（shop）
叔叔说这家营生就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那家商店。（shop）
1963 年母亲说，商店是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的商店。（shop）

The shop at the far counter, meaning the coin they kept for the children to count and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
